The complement reverses orientation and retains the same section measure. Lower-dimensional touches are area-null and pure-base allocations are whole-fiber choices.

The total allocated area |u|T is bounded by the maximum hyperplane section area of an enclosing ball for each fiber. Thus balance is integrable without a lower bound on |u|. Each effective measure has zero vector moment, so subtracting the full-body component gives the stated zero moment for R.

Checked h″+h for polygon edges, for point translations, and for a segment with two equal opposite normal atoms. A common interior ball bounds radial area elements in the polygonal approximation of a positive body. Balanced atomic approximants can be obtained by arc-vector integration, which preserves the exact moment. The rotated ordered edge vectors close and their one-decrease/one-increase projections keep each edge on its supporting line. A bounded Hausdorff limit then represents R, and the kernel of h″+h consists of translations.

Checked measurability of the supports of the actual cap bodies on proper strata, shortened facet segments, and fixed in-fiber zero-area points. Their uniformly bounded support-function integral lies below h_B, with area measure βS_B+S_J. Subtracting βh_B gives the first containment, and the complement gives a separate translation of −J. Taking difference bodies and areas gives the stated common minimum constant.

Nonnegative affine fiber weights are supported by the stated normal-localized identity. Their weighted section measure is carried through the same proof. The actual convexity inclusion at the integer weighted mean is in the required direction, and the weight on the centered three-site chain is constant.

For the centered triangle, summing its three normalized facet functionals forces translation asymmetry at least two. The centroid cap ratio 2/3 gives old-edge mean 2(2/3)/3=4/9 and J=(2/9)T. The crossed rectangles have endpoint area four each, middle side R+1/R, and |B|/M=9(R+1/R)^2/((R+1/R)^2+8). These checks use actual fibers. The archived polygonal check also passed 2,529 exact cases.
